verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API can record confirmed fraud outcomes. A Chargeback Event can be created against an order, and a Representment Outcome Event can be recorded, so outcome data does flow back into the Signifyd system. Nothing in the evidence says these outcomes retrain the model or update rules. There is also no mechanism for analysts' own review decisions to feed back. Missing for 10: documented model learning from submitted outcomes, analyst review decisions feeding back into models or Decision Center policies, rule-tuning suggestions from case outcomes, and any independent corroboration of a learning loop.
